# Legal & Medical-Advertising Compliance Checklist: Aesthetic Dermatology Clinic Marketing Website

**Purpose**: Lightweight sanity check of whether the spec's legal/medical-advertising requirements (의료법 disclosures, indicative pricing, side-effect tone, trademark exclusion, footer disclosures, and the open KakaoTalk/legal-review dependencies) are complete, unambiguous, and ready for a client/legal sign-off pass before `/speckit-plan`.
**Created**: 2026-09-11
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete, and it does not mean legal/advertising sign-off has been obtained.

## Requirement Completeness

- [ ] CHK001 Is the exact disclosure wording required under 의료법 제45조 비급여 진료비용 고지 specified anywhere, or does the spec define only the display *format* (indicative-pricing note placement)? [Completeness, Spec §FR-018]
- [ ] CHK002 Does the spec identify which pieces of Treatments copy (pricing disclosure, side-effect text, effect claims) still require 의료광고 심의 sign-off versus which are considered final as written? [Completeness, Spec §FR-018, Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK003 Are the footer legal disclosure fields (FR-024) checked against the complete statutory list for a Korean medical advertising surface, or only the six fields currently enumerated? [Completeness, Gap, Spec §FR-024]
- [ ] CHK004 Are the KakaoTalk channel's public ID, app-not-installed fallback behavior, and staffed-hours confirmation captured as concrete requirements anywhere, or only as an open marker? [Completeness, Gap, Spec §Key Entities, Edge Cases]

## Requirement Clarity

- [ ] CHK005 Is "calm, factual, non-alarming register" for side-effect content (FR-017) defined with criteria a reviewer could apply consistently across different treatments, or is it left to subjective judgment? [Clarity, Spec §FR-017]
- [ ] CHK006 Is it specified whether a posted price represents the clinic's standard rate, a minimum, or a per-session figure, so the "indicative pricing" disclosure (FR-010) is unambiguous to a visitor? [Clarity, Ambiguity, Spec §FR-010, Assumptions]

## Requirement Consistency

- [ ] CHK007 Are the trademark-exclusion requirement (FR-009, content/nav/URL/metadata) and the internal-reference mapping requirement stated consistently, i.e., does the spec guarantee the mapping is excluded from anything that ships to the published site? [Consistency, Spec §FR-009]

## Dependencies & Assumptions

- [ ] CHK008 Is the assumption that "final legal/advertising-compliance review is a launch dependency" paired with an owner and a point at which it must be resolved, or only recorded as a general risk? [Assumption, Spec Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK009 Are the consequences specified for what happens to the launch timeline if the client cannot supply KakaoTalk channel details or legal sign-off before other work is complete? [Gap, Spec Assumptions, Edge Cases]

## Traceability & Verification Readiness

- [ ] CHK010 Does the spec define a way to confirm, before launch, that no page content, navigation label, URL, or metadata exposes a brand/device trademark (FR-009), or is this left to ad hoc review? [Gap, Measurability, Spec §FR-009]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation
- `/speckit-implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a gate and must not modify markers
- `checklists/requirements.md` has a separate built-in lifecycle maintained by `/speckit-specify` and `/speckit-clarify`
- This checklist does not substitute for actual 의료법 / 의료광고 심의 legal review — it only checks whether the *requirements about* that review are complete and clear
